summary: Skopos self-hosting binding for the Product UI Craft skill pack.
adaptationNotes: Existing Skopos UI code is supporting precedent, not automatic canonical design truth.
The routed console remains the product surface; generated portal output is derived evidence.
Visual rubric evidence cannot replace Skopos Verify and Readiness.
Treat local visual overrides as exceptional: preserve the bound component library's defaults and use project semantic tokens for application composition.
Use Skopos product terminology and audience knowledge from the bound sources; reusable examples guide judgment but do not define the product voice.
Search packages/ui/src and existing screen symbols before creating a component; follow established Skopos role names instead of mirroring task wording.

acceptance.reason: Accept the strengthened product-craft projection after repeated live UI polish, interaction, responsive, component-architecture, human-interface-writing, and visual-review evidence.
